Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Not the most powerful cyberdeck kit on the market, but capable of performing multiple tasks – even if it does require a little patience.

Neuroport Cyberdeck Port Operating System. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port can now only accept a Militech Paraline Cyberdeck, one of which is provided with purchase of this Operating System.

The Militech Paraline is a Cyberdeck with 14 slots that can install Programs or Hardware. While using this Cyberdeck, the user has one less NET Action every Turn (Minimum 1).

Slots: 14

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
